reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking metastable phase evolution to surface chemistry changes and improved passivation, though it assumes without justification that the evolved intermetallics will be enriched in protective-scale-forming elements and that the resulting oxide will be more protective rather than introducing galvanic or spallation issues.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on phase evolution, surface oxide characterization, and corrosion/oxidation performance, though the exact aging conditions and alloy composition are not specified.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the underexplored evolution-corrosion-oxidation link in Mg-containing lightweight HEAs, providing a testable mechanistic framework that would guide future alloy design and thermal processing studies.
